facts.fact: 邮件主题：Marshall, Alexandra——创伤性脑损伤后评估。
facts.anchor: SUBJECT: Re: Marshall, Alexandra—Post-Traumatic Brain Injury Evaluation

facts.fact: 入院：州警学院自卫训练中的脑震荡外伤；急性激越需镇静。
facts.anchor: concussive head trauma sustained during self-defense training at the Washington State Police Academy

facts.fact: 医史确认：既往严重 TBI——需要广泛干预与康复。
facts.anchor: prior severe traumatic brain injury requiring extensive intervention and rehabilitation

facts.fact: 强烈建议：立即移出任何涉及身体接触的训练或行动。
facts.anchor: she be immediately removed from any training or operational activity involving physical contact.

facts.fact: 警告：后续头部外伤可能导致累积性神经损伤（认知/运动/结构）。
facts.anchor: any subsequent head trauma is likely to result in cumulative neurological damage

facts.fact: 无医疗许可继续外勤——可能不可逆神经衰退或死亡。
facts.anchor: Further injury may result in irreversible neurological decline, or death.

facts.fact: 她违抗最强建议自己决定回学院——「决定在你们手里」。署名 Dr. Ethan McCabe。
facts.anchor: Ms. Marshall has elected to return to the academy against our strongest recommendations and despite the risks.
